profile.name: Alex Manev
profile.tagline: A home for my web apps, experiments, and projects.

apps.title: Timber Cut Planner
apps.description: List the timber you have and the pieces you need — it works out which boards to cut for the least offcut, or which lengths to buy, and lets you tick off each cut as you go.

apps.title: Flight Stopovers
apps.description: Pick a departure and arrival city and see every city you could connect through — one or two stops — drawn as routes on a world map.

apps.title: Baby's First Year
apps.description: A week-by-week health and growth plan from birth to one year — feeding schedule and log, appointments, age-appropriate activities, growth charts and every milestone, kept on your device.

apps.title: Contraction Timer
apps.description: A calm, private timer for labour contractions — track length, spacing, and whether a pattern is holding. Everything stays on your device.

apps.title: Hello World
apps.description: A minimal example app to show how a subpage is wired up. Copy this folder to start a new one.
